newsitem.title: USA: Minor earthquake shakes Tennessee, Kentucky.
newsitem.headline: Minor earthquake shakes Tennessee, Kentucky.

text.p: A minor earthquake measuring 3.8 on the Richter scale shook parts of eastern Tennessee and Kentucky on Wednesday, scientists said.
"It was a minor quake. We haven't heard any reports of damage," said geophysicist Waverly Person from the U.S. Geological Survey's National Earthquake Centre in Golden, Colorado.
The quake struck at 8:29 a.m. EDT and was centred 40 miles (64 km) northeast of Knoxville, Tennesses, near the Kentucky border.
It could be felt in eastern Tennessee, Kentucky and the southwest corner of Virginia, Person said.
